title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone users can zoom the page
reason: Viewport meta is width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no; zoom is allowed

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Read the "viewport" meta tag of the page.
Does the viewport meta tag allow zoom (no "maximum-scale=1" and no "user-scalable=no")?
steps.saw: No maximum-scale and no user-scalable in the viewport meta
